skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The clothes Perfumer wore during her return to Athenius.
A combination of professional practicality and aesthetic beauty. The many pouches hold medicines, while the floral decorations match the ambience of Athenius.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
New buds sprout, while the breeze caresses her cheek. Her hometown has changed a lot, yet it hasn't changed at all.
Her clothes from Rhodes Island give her peace of mind, and now, she can stand tall and look to the future.
